25.original: Contact your allies from the designated location.

27.original: Speak with Milos in residential radius 9-14.

48.original: Heading below? I'd be glad to show you the way!

50.original: The Endless Sphene was just a projected image outside Living Memory, so it was a bit of a surprise to see an actual item that belonged to her.

51.original: On the way back, I asked Shale why the tiara might have been in the throne room.

52.original: She believes that it was being used to record Sphene's actions. There's no way to tell now whether or not it was with her knowledge...

53.original: But it can't be used for questionable ends anymore, so we can at least take comfort in that.

55.original: The interference made it impossible to locate you, and prevented linkpearl transmissions besides...

56.original: Apologies that we couldn't be there for the critical moment, but as usual you found a way to handle matters.

57.original: Calyx seems to consider the reflections naught but fields to be harvested for his Endless.

58.original: I do not make a habit of dismissing the assertions of others out of hand, but I cannot abide such callous disregard for life.

59.original: Based on the geographic data I gathered, it seems the inner section containing the castle served as a residential area during the early stages of Everkeep's construction.

60.original: The outer section was then added when they expanded the structure into its present-day shape. I expect the system to dry the earth was installed so that they could build a stable foundation on submerged land.

61.original: The simulant gave the impression that she wouldn't be back, but I suppose only time will tell. And at present, we have no further leads on Calyx...

62.original: For now, perhaps you could take a moment to contact our friends.

63.original: It would be good to catch each other up on recent developments, and I am certain everyone would appreciate hearing from you.

64.original: Come to think of it, I have no idea what Erenville's up to...

65.original: I'll take a look at the Preservation terminal. Hopefully there'll be something useful.

66.original: I shall take the opportunity to review the books from the castle...and one grimoire in particular.

67.original: Most of the tomes we found were dilapidated from age, but some are thankfully still legible.

68.original: Y'shtola, Alphinaud, Alisaie, and Erenville should all be somewhere within the dome. Pray do the honors in any order you like.

69.original: It irks me to think we're being led on by Calyx, but I'll do my best to find clues of his passage.

75.original: (-Y'shtola-)If it isn't <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Is something the matter?

76.original: (-Y'shtola-)...So Preservation is behind the recent intrigue. It doesn't surprise me. I'm glad to hear you are none the worse for your trials, though.

77.original: (-Y'shtola-)As for myself, I've just concluded a meeting with Gossan. I told him about the cure for levin sickness, and we formed a tentative plan to treat all those who are stricken.

78.original: (-Y'shtola-)I'm now otherwise unoccupied, so I shall take a look around the government sector to see if aught is amiss.

79.original: (-Y'shtola-)And if this Calyx is obsessed with the key, then I ought to begin studying it in earnest as well.

80.original: (-Alphinaud-)Ah, excellent timing, my friend. I had a mind to call you myself to see how you were faring.

81.original: (-Alphinaud-)Calyx... While something was obviously afoot, I couldn't have imagined that such an individual would be involved.

82.original: (-Alphinaud-)'Tis well you were able to prevent the simulant from sowing further uncertainty. That said, her absence may have consequences.

83.original: (-Alphinaud-)The people of Alexandria still have great trust in Sphene─'tis plain in the way they speak of her even now, and in how the simulant was able to win them over.

84.original: (-Alphinaud-)When they notice she has ceased to appear again, rumor and worry will spread. We must be mindful of any pronounced shift in the mood of the populace.

85.original: (-Alphinaud-)But forgive me─it's been battle after battle for you, hasn't it? We can handle ourselves for now, so pray rest up while you can and recover your strength.

86.original: (-Alisaie-)Yes, hello! ...<hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!? For you to call out of the blue, is something wrong?

87.original: (-Alisaie-)...What? You went all the way to the bottom of Everkeep, and you didn't think to ask me to come!?

88.original: (-Alisaie-)<sigh> But I suppose I've been fairly busy myself...

89.original: (-Alisaie-)I'm pleased to say that we've received permission to begin administering the cure for levin sickness to citizens.

90.original: (-Alisaie-)I'm actually due to visit a boy named Milos shortly, to see how he is responding to his treatment.

91.original: (-Alisaie-)You've met him before with Lamaty'i, I believe? The two of you should attend as well if you have time.

92.original: (-Erenville-)<hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, this is a surprise. Has Wuk Lamat gotten into trouble again?

93.original: (-Erenville-)...I see. Knowing you, I expect you're already looking forward to the next obvious trap. Try not to overdo it.

94.original: (-Erenville-)I'm in the outskirts at the moment. I've been helping the people with their work, and talking to those I meet to gauge their sentiment.

95.original: (-Erenville-)It's been uneventful for the most part, but there was one notable development.

96.original: (-Erenville-)Following recent events, some here stopped wearing regulators. This has led to a disparity in what people remember about the queen's death, and the occasional episode of confusion.

97.original: (-Erenville-)I'll be sure to let you know if there are any other changes.

98.original: Being able to contact people so far away so easily can do wonders for your peace of mind. Linkpearls really are convenient things.

99.original: I see you were able to reach everyone. That is well.

100.original: I thought I heard Alisaie yelling. I hope everything is all right...

101.original: What did the others have to say, if I may ask?

102.original: They've finished treating Milos? Then we have to go and visit him!

103.original: Would you mind if I accompanied you? I understand he's afflicted with the selfsame condition as I was, and I cannot help but worry for him.

104.original: Of course, we don't mind at all.

105.original: In the meantime, I shall take myself around Solution Nine and see how things are.

106.original: I share Alphinaud's concern about the queen's absence. And even setting that aside, the situation is not like to resolve itself while becoming Endless remains an option.

107.original: I had been meaning to visit some shops, so I shall join Krile.

108.original: While everyone's out and about, I'll try to pick up Calyx's trail. I'll see if I can dig up some information about the key for Y'shtola as well.

110.original: It seems we all have things to do. Still, there's no telling what else Calyx might have planned...so please be careful, everyone.

111.original: Right, let's go to Milos's apartment. It's in residential radius 9-14, if I remember correctly.

112.original: Lamaty'i told me all about Milos. She said he was around my age, but couldn't leave his bed.

113.original: I'd like to go meet him next time. Maybe we can be friends.

114.original: Calyx is more clever than anyone has any right to be, but I'll sniff him out somehow. Just leave it to me.

115.original: Look, Milos is sitting up! I'd seen the treatment before, so I knew it would work...but it's still so amazing! Alisaie and Y'shtola are miracle workers!

116.original: I understand my Endless self visited Milos often. I will keep quiet, so as to not draw suspicion.

117.original: There you are. Next time something is in the offing, you had better remember to call on me!

118.original: It's so good to see you again, and a delight to know that you and Alisaie are friends. She's been very kind to us.

119.original: H-Hello... You came before...with Queen Sphene... I'm glad...I'm glad you came again...

120.original: I believe he'll be fine now. But just for good measure, I'll administer a healing spell.
